title: Senki Zesshou Symphogear G: Senki Zesshou Shinai Symphogear
justification: AniList 20452 has 2 episodes (2014-02-05, 2014-03-05; English 'Non-Songs of the Valkyries'). AniDB 9465 S1, S2 are 'The Non-Songs of the Valkyries 1, 2' on 2014-02-05 and 2014-03-05; TVDB 254667 0x01, 0x02 are 'Not-So-Superb Song of the Valkyries: Symphogear 1, 2' on the same days and TMDB tv/63322 S0E1-2 agree. S3 'Miku Kohinata Transformation' (undated) is another item.
